Nina (Finance): Hey team — HelioTech hit a weird spike on invoice INV-2025-1583, looks like a meter ID switch caused duplicate ingest for 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-03. Can someone help with a manual credit + promo apply? Amount ~ $4,250. @Maya FYI
Sam (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice + the offending lines? also which promo to apply? :eyes:
Nina (Finance): INV-2025-1583
Attached lines (from billing export):
```
customer,invoice,period_start,period_end,metric,quantity,unit_price,charge
helio,INV-2025-1583,2025-03-01,2025-03-03,ingest_documents,120000,0.03,3600.00
helio,INV-2025-1583,2025-03-01,2025-03-03,ingest_documents,25000,0.03,750.00
```
Looks like the meter change duplicated 25k docs. Total duplicate = $750. But the customer also lost a previously applied 10% pilot promo for the month due to system mismatch (~$3,500). Combined manual goodwill + promo = $4,250.
Oliver (Revenue): Need GL and approval note. Is this on Redwood pilot promo code PILOT-APR? If so, we can apply promo credit plus a goodwill line. Also confirm accounting impact: revenue vs contra revenue.
Nina (Finance): Correct — promo is `PILOT-APR` (should have applied to entire month but didn't). Customer requested quick resolution; they've escalated to their CFO.
Maya (Finance Manager): OK, I'm 👍 to the manual adjustment. Please create an accounting ticket with these fields: invoice=INV-2025-1583, amount=4250.00, reason="meter_id duplicate + missed pilot promo", GL=6102, tag=manual_credit. Once ticket is created reply with ticket ID and I'll sign off.
Sam (Billing Ops): Created ticket FIN-2025-4877 with the CSV attached and journaling entries. I've added `GL:6102` and `external_note: HelioTech CFO escalated`. Applied a temporary negative line item to the draft invoice for -4250.00 (will hold until approval). Link: https://tickets.internal/FIN-2025-4877
Maya (Finance Manager): Approved. Please schedule the actual refund/credit in the next batch and confirm with the customer.
finance-bot: Adjustment logged; id=adj-2025-7683; status=pending_approval; created_by=Sam; ticket=FIN-2025-4877
Sam (Billing Ops): Notified customer support to send confirmation email once processed. I'll post final transaction ID after settlement. :white_check_mark:
Nina (Finance): Thanks all — flagging for month-end close. I'll add a line to the recs spreadsheet.
